items.title: Citius Pharmaceuticals Announces a Registered Direct Offering of $6.0 Million Priced At-The-Market Under Nasdaq Rules
items.summary: Citius Pharmaceuticals Inc. (Nasdaq: CTXR) ("Citius Pharma" or the "Company"), a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to the development and commercialization of first-in-class critical care products, today announced that it has entered into definitive agreement for the purchase of an aggregate of 3,973,510 shares of its common stock (or pre-funded warrants in lieu thereof) and accompanying common warrants to purchase up to an aggregate of 3,973,510 shares of its common stock, at a purchase price of $1.51 per share (or pre-funded warrant in lieu thereof) and accompanying common warrant in a registered direct offering priced at-the-market under Nasdaq rules. The common warrants will have an exercise price of $1.40 per share, will be exercisable immediately upon issuance, and will expire five years from the initial exercise date.
